releaseNotes: v1.8.13: Fix grok-cli BaseURL endpoint to /v1/responses resolving upstream 404 errors on gcli/* models (fixes #2), prioritize custom providerNodes prefixes over built-in aliases to prevent shadowing of oa/cc/etc. (fixes #3), map internal providerNode row IDs to user-configured prefixes in /v1/models and /v1/models/*, and expand customModels catalog ingestion to include all routable model types with key-fallback parsing.
